Entries.611173/Hn pamHouseUpgrade: 50s/71 68/farmer 66 62 2 Robin 67 66 2 Pam 71 71 0 Penny 72 71 0/skippable/move farmer 0 4 2/faceDirection Robin 3/speak Robin "ሄይ @! እንግዲህ... ምን ${ይመስልሃል^ይመስልሻል}$?"/move farmer 0 1 1/faceDirection Robin 2/emote farmer 32/pause 500/speak Robin "ስለሥራው ጥሩ ስሜት አለኝ...#$b#በእርግጥ፣ እስካሁን ከሠራኋቸው ሁሉ የተሻለው ሊሆን ይችላል!$h"/pause 500/faceDirection Robin 1/speak Robin "ክብ መስኮቱን ተመልከት... ፍሬሙን እንደዚያ ማጠፍ በጣም፣ በጣም ከባድ ነበር።#$b#ኦህ፣ በበሩ ላይ ያሉትን ውስብስብ ቅርጾችም ተመልከት። ለዘላለም የወሰደ መሰለኝ። አስተውለሃቸዋል?"/emote farmer 40/speak Robin "ኦህ... ሄህ። እንደገና ስለ እንጨት ብዙ እያወራሁ ነው መሰለኝ... አይደል?$h"/move Robin 0 1 3/speak Robin "ለማንኛውም፣ ሄጄ ላነጋግራቸው ነው... ግን መጀመሪያ መጠየቅ አለብኝ..."/question fork0 "ለዚህ ክፍያውን ${አንተ^አንቺ}$ ${እንደከፈልክ^እንደከፈልሽ}$ እንድነግራቸው ${ትፈልጋለህ^ትፈልጊያለሽ}$?#አዎ፣ በእርግጥ!#አይ፣ ስሜ ሳይገለጽ ቢቀር እመርጣለሁ"/fork choseToBeKnown_pennySpouse/pause 200/speak Robin "እሺ... እንግዲህ ${አንተ^አንቺ}$ እዚህ ቆይ።"/pause 500/move Robin 0 1 2/move farmer 2 0 2 true/move Robin 0 3 1 false/move Robin 2 0 1/faceDirection Pam 3/move Penny 0 -1 3/move Penny -1 0 3/speak Robin "ሰላም፣ ጎረቤቶች... እዚያ ያለው ጥሩ አዲስ ቤት ነው!$4"/pause 50/playMusic musicboxsong/speak Pam "ሮቢን... እኔ... ምን ልል እንዳለብኝ አላውቅም...$s#$b#ይህ ሕልም እውን የሆነበት ነው... ሁልጊዜ የፈለግሁት ይህን ብቻ ነው።$s"/faceDirection Pam 2/animate Pam false true 100 25/pause 1000/animate Pam false true 150 26 27/pause 1000/speak Penny "ሮቢን፣ በጣም አመሰግናለሁ...$s"/speak Robin "ሄይ፣ እኔን አታመስግኚኝ! ሌላ ሰው ነው ሐሳቡን ያመጣው... ለሁሉም ነገር ${የከፈለውም እሱ ነው^የከፈለችውም እሷ ናት}$።"/pause 100/stopAnimation Pam/showFrame Pam 12/faceDirection Penny 2/animate Penny false true 100 23/pause 500/speak Penny "ታዲያ... ማን?$s"/stopAnimation Pam/faceDirection Pam 3/stopAnimation Penny/faceDirection Penny 3/pause 500/faceDirection Robin 2/speak Robin "መናገር አልችልም... ስማቸው ሳይገለጽ እንዲቀር አጥብቀው ጠይቀዋል።$5"/pause 500/faceDirection Penny 2/faceDirection Pam 0/faceDirection Penny 3 true/faceDirection Pam 3 true/faceDirection Robin 1/pause 300/speak Pam "...ምናልባት ዕዳ እንዳለብን እንዳይሰማን ስማቸውን ሳይገልጹ ቀሩ።"/faceDirection Pam 2/speak Pam "ማንም ሁን... በእውነት ንጹሕ መልአክ ${ነህ^ነሽ}$...$s"/pause 300/speak Robin "ደህና፣ እስከ *ዚያ* ድረስ አልሄድም...$4"/jump farmer/animate farmer false true 100 94/pause 500/animate Robin false true 100 32 33/pause 2000/stopAnimation Robin/showFrame Robin 0/stopAnimation farmer/faceDirection Robin 1/faceDirection Pam 0/faceDirection Penny 2/speak Pam "ፔኒ፣ በቆሻሻ ሁኔታ ማደግ ስለነበረብሽ ይቅርታ... ግን ጥሩ ቤት በማግኘትሽ በጣም ደስ ብሎኛል። አሁን ሁለታችንም አግኝተናል።#$b#አሁን ጥሩ ሕይወት ለመኖር የምችለውን ሁሉ እሞክራለሁ...$s"/emote Penny 20/pause 100/animate Penny false true 200 0 1 2 3/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 500/positionOffset Penny 0 8/animate Penny false true 100 39/warp Pam -100 -100/playSound coin/pause 3000/fade/viewport -2000 -2000/pause 400/playMusic none/addConversationTopic pamHouseUpgradeAnonymous/pause 1000/end

እዚህ ምን ${እያደረግክ^እያደረግሽ}$ ነው?"/speak Robin "ምን፣ ስለዚህ ጉዳይ ${ለሚስትህ^ለሚስትሽ}$ አልነገርካትም፣ @?$u"/faceDirection Robin 0/faceDirection farmer 2/pause 100/faceDirection Robin 1/speak Robin "@ ይህን ሐሳብ አመጣና ለሁሉም ነገር ከፈለ!"/faceDirection farmer 1/stopAnimation Pam/showFrame Pam 12/pause 500/speak Penny "@... ይህን ማድረግ ${አላስፈለገህም^አላስፈለገሽም}$...#$b#ግን አመሰግናለሁ። ይህ ለእኔ ብዙ ማለት ነው።$s"/stopAnimation Pam/faceDirection Pam 3/stopAnimation Penny/faceDirection Penny 3/pause 300/speak Pam "ይህ ብዙ ገንዘብ ወጥቶበት መሆን አለበት፣ @...$s#$b#...እውነቱን ለመናገር፣ ይህ ትንሽ ያሳፍራል። ለዚህ ${ውለታህን^ውለታሽን}$ እንዴት ${ልመልስልህ^ልመልስልሽ}$ እችላለሁ?$4"/pause 300/question fork1 "...#አንቺ የእኔ 'እማማ' ነሽ! ምንም ውለታ መመለስ አያስፈልግም!#ፔኒን በተሻለ ሁኔታ በመያዝ መጀመር ትችያለሽ..."/fork itsagift_pennySpouse/pause 500/faceDirection Pam 2/showFrame Pam 25/pause 250/faceDirection Penny 2/speak Pam "...ይቅርታ።$s"/pause 500/speak Pam "የምትለኝን ሁሉ አደርጋለሁ...$s"/pause 500/animate Robin false true 150 34 35/pause 500/speak Penny "እማማ...$s"/faceDirection Pam 0/speak Penny "አትጨነቂ... አንዳንዴ ለምን እንደምትቆጪ ይገባኛል። ሕይወትሽ ቀላል አልነበረም...$s"/stopAnimation Robin/faceDirection Robin 1/speak Pam "አመሰግናለሁ፣ ልጄ።$h#$b#ከአሁን በኋላ እንደ እውነተኛ ቤተሰብ እንሆናለን... ሰማሽኝ?#$b#ከእንግዲህ ሁልጊዜ እንዲህ መራር መሆን አልፈልግም...$s#$b#ሕይወቴን ለመቀየር እሞክራለሁ..."/emote Penny 20/pause 100/animate Penny false true 200 0 1 2 3/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 0 2/pause 500/positionOffset Penny 0 8/animate Penny false true 100 39/warp Pam -100 -100/playSound coin/pause 3000/fade/viewport -2000 -2000/pause 400/playMusic none/pause 1000/end
